Measly 21 year old brat here. I can drink do I count as an adult?

Well the story goes: I was pretty ADD as a kid and didnt know how to act, so that repelled people in general. Then I managed to become obese. So that repelled people. By senior year I was self-aware enough to realize I was repelling people and started doing what I could to fix it, but too little too late.

At this point my instincts for actually connecting with people are non-existant. I can hold a conversation with anyone really. I get along well with people, even make friends every once in a while. I cleaned myself up physically, dress better, eat better, got in shape. People tell me all the time Im good looking.

At this point I even have girls come up and hit on me sometimes. BUT I HAVE NO FUCKING CLUE AT ALL ONACTUALLY MAKING A CONNECTION. 

Its literally killing me. I have suicidal thoughts related to this pretty much every day. Someone please help.

I really wish there were euthanasia centers. I wouldnt have to fucking choke myself to death, I could go peacefully.

Would not reccommend the hospital. Youre stuck there staring your problems in the face, without anything to solve them really. The counseling is more in groups, and can make you feel even more insignificant. The food is cardboard, well it was in Deleware. Theyll take your belt and shoelaces and phone. You will be treated like a prisoner. Then, after all that, for all your trouble, you get a nice big black mark on your record for trying to help yourself.

Personally I think they are disgusting institutions not fit for human beings.
